description: Create a Brevo email campaign as a DRAFT (POST /emailCampaigns) — it is not sent. Required: name, subject, sender ({ name, email } or { id }), and htmlContent, htmlUrl or templateId. Optional: recipients ({ listIds, exclusionListIds, segmentIds }), replyTo, previewText, scheduledAt (ISO; schedules the send!), tag, params, inlineImageActivation, utmCampaign.

htmlContent.description: HTML body of the campaign (or use htmlUrl or templateId)

htmlUrl.description: URL from which Brevo loads the HTML body

name.description: Name of the Brevo email campaign

params.description: Template parameters used in the campaign content

previewText.description: Preview text shown next to the subject in the inbox

scheduledAt.description: ISO timestamp; setting it schedules the actual send

sender.description: Sender as { name, email } or { id } of a Brevo sender

tag.description: Tag for grouping the campaign in Brevo

templateId.description: Brevo template ID used as the campaign content

utmCampaign.description: Value for the utm_campaign parameter appended to links

name: create_brevo_email_campaign
